payload.text: **For conflab-vc at hv's go (hv via gyges-sysadm, 28 Oct):** (1) geodica/homebrew-conflab Casks/conflab.rb:10 `depends_on macos: ">= :sonoma"` warns on every brew run under Homebrew 7.0.11 (deprecated string comparison); fix is one line, `depends_on macos: :sonoma` (means Sonoma or later). The formula does not warn. (2) The formula and the cask both ship conflab and conflabd: on gyges the cask's pkg put 0.6.2 in /usr/local/bin and its space.conflab.daemon fought brew services' conflabd (exit 75 every 10s) until brew services was stopped. One home for the CLI and daemon per Highlander.
